biography: Ojas Surve, hailing from the bustling streets of Mumbai, wasn't born into motorsport royalty. His journey began with a beat-up go-kart salvaged from a scrapyard, a gift from his mechanically inclined father. Ojas honed his skills on makeshift tracks carved out of abandoned industrial estates, dodging potholes and stray dogs with equal aplomb. His raw talent caught the eye of a local racing patron, who sponsored his entry into regional karting championships. A defining moment came at the 2015 JK Tyre National Racing Championship, where, despite starting last due to a mechanical failure, Ojas clawed his way to victory with a daring last-lap overtake. Now, at the peak of his career, driving for VW Virtus, Ojas aims to cement his legacy on the global stage, blending raw talent with calculated aggression.
drivingStyle: Ojas is an aggressive, flamboyant driver known for his late-braking maneuvers and fearless overtaking. He attacks corners with an almost reckless abandon, often pushing the limits of his car and tires. While this occasionally leads to costly mistakes, it also results in breathtaking displays of speed and precision. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest. Tire management is not his strongest suit, often relying on raw speed to compensate for early wear.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Moreau
rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor in the same racing series, their rivalry is fueled by contrasting driving styles – Isabelle being smooth and calculated, Ojas being aggressive and instinctive. They often clash on track, leading to controversial incidents.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A rival from their karting days, Kenji has always been one step ahead in terms of resources and opportunities, fostering a deep-seated desire in Ojas to prove his superiority.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Silva
rivalries.reason: A veteran racer with a reputation for playing mind games, Ricardo often uses psychological tactics to unsettle Ojas, leading to intense on-track battles and heated exchanges off track.

quirks: Always wears a lucky wristband gifted by his grandmother before every race.
Listens to Bollywood music at full volume in the paddock to psych himself up.
Has a specific ritual of cleaning his helmet visor exactly seven times before putting it on.
famousQuote: "Speed is not just about how fast you go, but how much you're willing to risk."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2020 Macau Grand Prix after a thrilling three-way battle in the final laps, showcasing his exceptional racecraft and nerve under immense pressure.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the 2022 Championship due to a rare mechanical failure, costing him the title and leaving him devastated.
